items.title: Lars Edegran Interview, 1965-09-27
items.q: It would have sounded a lot better if Sammy Hopkins would have been there.

ctx.x: I see. Well, how did the music go? Pretty well, huh? Oh, pretty bad.

Pretty bad. Mainly because they didn't have any rehearsal. It was supposed to be rehearsal but Tashaki had to leave the next day or the same night so he didn't have time. It would have sounded a lot better if Sammy Hopkins would have been there. Because he was actually out to practice a lot. He couldn't do much. It would have sounded better without him, I think. And another drummer, this drummer didn't fit in very well, yeah. He was swinging but didn't fit in the style. He couldn't play on the snare drum or…
Who are some of your favorite musicians that you've heard here, say on bass?
